finalText:
Build now finishes clean with exit code 0.

Root cause: the bundler bump changed the shape of what it hands modules — `options.retries` became `options.retryCount`, and unset flags now come back as `undefined` instead of `false`. Two call sites weren't updated for that:

- `src/core/options.js:7` — `resolveRetries` read the old `options.retries` key (now `undefined`, so `.toFixed()` threw). Fixed to read `options.retryCount`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js:8` — `isBackoffEnabled` only handled explicit `true`/`false` and threw on `undefined`. Added an `undefined` → `false` case to match the new loader's "unset" convention.

The remaining ~8 warnings in the log are genuine deprecation noise from the dependency bump (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()` constructor, sync loader hooks, `punycode`, etc.) plus a couple of lint-style notices (unused export, circular import) — none of those block the build; they're worth cleaning up eventually but weren't the thing breaking things.
